notes:
• My tickets is now called Tickets, and Search finds any ticket, open or closed, along with clients, contacts and, if you use Quoting or Billing, quotes and invoices.
• Press T anywhere to search tickets, or O to search clients.
• Search remembers the tickets and clients you opened recently, and you can save a search as a list to come back to.
• You can now split one booking into a billable part and a part that isn't, with the Split link next to the billing choice.
• If a week's timesheet is already submitted in ConnectWise, the app now says so instead of failing quietly, and keeps your time so it isn't lost.
• My time shows which weeks are submitted.
• Settings and the sign-in screen have a fresh look, and Settings has a new page of tips for getting more out of TimeBot Jr.
• Error messages are easier to read on every theme.
• Moving around the app has a little motion now, so it's easier to see where you are, and it stays still if your computer is set to reduce motion.
• Some pages load a bit faster.
• Picking several tickets now offers the same actions in Tickets, Search and Support desk.
• For managers: You can now change an entry in To review even after it's marked Ready to bill.
